style_base: Highly polished 2D/3D hybrid comic-book animation, cel-shaded with bold black ink outlines, halftone Ben-Day dot shading, CMYK offset-print chromatic aberration on edges, kinetic smear frames and dynamic action lines, graffiti-pop accents in burnt orange #ff5a1f against a moody dark gunmetal gym, dramatic rim lighting, confident athletic man in dark training gear performing the exercise with textbook form, seamless 5-second loop, camera locked at a low three-quarter angle, no text, no logos, no watermarks
